name: Rosso di Montalcino

climate: Sangiovese sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

notes: It tastes much like Brunello but is often lighter in body and easier to drink young.

blurb.text: A red wine from the commune of Montalcino in Tuscany, made only from Sangiovese.
